name_input: CHOWDHRY RUBBER & CHEMICAL PVT. LTD.; CHOWDHRY RUBBER & CHEMICAL PRIVATE LIMITED; CHOWDHRY RUBBER & CHEMICAL PVT. LTD.; CHOWDHARY RUBBER & CHEMICAL PVT LTD; CHOWDHRY RUBBER & CHEMICAL PRIVATE LIMITED; CHOWDHRY RUBBER & CHEMICAL PRIVATE LIMITED; M/S CHOUDHRY RUBBER & CHEMICAL (P) LTD; CHOWDHRY RUBBER AND CHEMICAL PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs records, page for CHOWDHRY RUBBER AND CHEMICAL PRIVATE LIMITED (Delhi address 19/310/40 Old Rohtak Road, Shehzada Bagh): "2025-09-20 | CHOWDHRY RUBBER AND CHEMICAL PRIVATE LIMITED | SURBHI SLIPPER INDUSTRIES | CARBON BLACK N-330 | JOGBANI, India | BIRATNAGAR, NEPAL | 28030010 | 2313548" and "2025-09-18 | CHOWDHRY RUBBER AND CHEMICAL PRIVATE LIMITED | ASVN PLAST INDUSTRIES | CARBONBLACK N-550 (25KG) | SONAULI, India | BHAIRAWA, NEPAL | 28030010 | 6338541". Source counter: page header states "Total Shipments 58 Records detected" for this entity; 5 shipment rows actually rendered in the free view (3 import rows + 2 export rows). Export rows actually seen: 2, both dated September 2025, both to Nepal, both HS 28030010 (carbon black).
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report split was retrievable: eximpedia.app and trademo.com returned HTTP 403, volza.com returned HTTP 403, and DuckDuckGo search was unavailable (connection refused) throughout the session, so no domestic-supply source could be opened. The only India-side signal is the Chennai/Mundra/JNPT import footprint on the main ImportKey page ("Total Shipments 571 Records detected", "Latest Cargo 2025-11-28", e.g. "2025-11-28 | ADVANCE MATERIALS PTE.LIMITED | CHOWDHRY RUBBER & CHEMICAL PRIVATE LIMITED | EVA 2518 CO | SAUDI ARABIA, Singapore | CHENNAI SEA, India | 39013000 | 6700597"), which evidences inbound polymer trade and an operating Indian buyer entity, not domestic outbound supply. Domestic supply therefore remains unverified, not confirmed.
note: Two distinct legal entities appear under near-identical names and must not be merged: (1) CHOWDHRY RUBBER & CHEMICAL PRIVATE LIMITED, Chennai (42/2 Madhavaram High Road, Vadakarai Post, Redhills) — 571 records, latest 2025-11-28, predominantly IMPORTS of EVA/EPDM/ABS/silicones from Saudi Arabia, Singapore, Korea, Thailand, China; (2) CHOWDHRY RUBBER AND CHEMICAL PRIVATE LIMITED, Delhi (19/310/40 Old Rohtak Road, Shehzada Bagh) — 58 records, latest 2025-09-27, mixed import and export. The confirmed exports (2 rows, Sept 2025, Nepal, HS 28030010) belong to the Delhi entity. IMPORTANT HS DISCREPANCY: declared HS codes in the request are 292700 / 390110 / 390190 / 390769, but every shipment row actually observed carries 39013000 (EVA), 40027000 (EPDM), 39033000 (ABS), 39095000, 39100090 (silicones) and 28030010 (carbon black) — none of the four declared codes appears in any observed record. Per project rule 3 this is NOT grounds for rejection: the company stays in the base and the HS code should be corrected to the factual codes above. Role: trader/distributor of rubber and polymer raw materials (buys from LG Chem, Daelim, S&C Corporation, IRPC, SIPCHEM, Dow, Jiangxi Bluestar; sells carbon black onward to Nepali slipper/plast manufacturers) — i.e. manufacturer_trader/trader, not a producer. Revenue and export volume: null — no public figures found; ImportKey free view exposes shipment counts only, not values, and no GST or annual-report data was reachable. Sanctions/litigation: not assessed in this pass, and per rule 2 would not affect the verdict. Net: real, dated, documented cross-border shipments exist in both directions, so this is not a 'no trace of supply' case; domestic Indian-market supply is the one unproven leg.
